weapon.d: If unit initiates combat, inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-4 on foe during combat.
If unit initiates combat, inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-4 on foe during combat.

If foe initiates combat or foe's HP ≥ 75% at start of combat, inflicts Atk/Spd/Res-5 on foe, deals damage = 20% of unit's Res (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and grants Special cooldown charge +1 to unit per attack during combat (only highest value applied; does not stack), and restores 7 HP to unit after combat.

special.d: Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 30% during combat.
Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 50% during combat.

a.d: If unit initiates combat, grants Res+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Res+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Res+4 during combat.

c.d: At start of turn, inflicts Spd-3 on foes in cardinal directions with Res < unit's Res through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Spd-4 on foes in cardinal directions with Res < unit's Res through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Spd-5 on foes in cardinal directions with Res < unit's Res through their next actions.
